title: The Most Underused Cybersecurity Strategy Is to Have Less to Defend
description: This content discusses the cybersecurity strategy of reducing the attack surface by minimizing unnecessary technology complexity within enterprise environments. It highlights recent high-severity PHP vulnerabilities that prompted urgent advisories and temporary website shutdowns, illustrating challenges in identifying and patching embedded vulnerable components. The article emphasizes that many enterprises accumulate redundant applications and dependencies over time, increasing security obligations without proportional business value. Reducing unnecessary software and infrastructure can lower risk and improve security sustainability.
